BUILD-A-SUPERHERO
What's New
V8.0.2
DC portraits + Perfect Hero
New DC images and more ways to hit #1
  • Embedded working portraits for Black Canary, Doctor Fate, Beast Boy, Blue Beetle, Mister Terrific, Plastic Man, Metamorpho, Steel, Firestorm, Captain Boomerang, Katana, Swamp Thing, Peacemaker, Harley Quinn, Static and Booster Gold.
  • New possibilities added to DC Perfect Hero for a number 1 rating.
V8.0.1
Hero Team recap rewrite
Character-specific plus/minus lines, cleaner grammar
  • Hero Team recaps no longer reuse the same sentence on both picks.
  • Each Marvel character now has their own benefit and drawback for every role.
  • Matchup lines describe the actual people in the seat instead of generic “needs protection” / “ends the 1-on-1” copy.
  • On phones, the team boards tuck away during the recap so the verdict is readable.
V8.0.0
Perfect Hero — DC
A separate DC Perfect Hero mode with curated DC pools
  • Added PERFECT HERO — DC. It appears when the DC filter is selected.
  • Same rules as Marvel: five locked slots, no skips, no respins, duplicates allowed, ratings hidden until the end.
  • DC uses its own character pool, optimal lists, and hidden category orders. Marvel Perfect Hero is unchanged.
  • 5/5 optimal is still guaranteed #1. 4/5 is still guaranteed #2. Lower tiers still use hidden quality + build seed.
V7.1.1
Custom tab icon
A unique lightning badge now sits in the browser tab
  • Replaced the default globe with a custom purple-and-cyan lightning badge that matches the game.
  • The icon is embedded in the file, so it works offline and does not need a separate favicon upload.
V7.1.0
Hero Team recap + role identity
Enemy team wording, better recaps, and iconic role bonuses
  • The opposing side is now the Enemy Team instead of “AI.”
  • Role recaps no longer copy the same minus onto both picks. Each character gets a benefit and a drawback that fits that person in that seat.
  • Scoring now gives a small identity bonus when a natural leader sits Captain, a wall sits Tank, a closer sits Duelist, or a reality-warper sits Support — and a penalty when the body clearly does not belong there.
  • The match summary now points at the actual deciding seat instead of contradicting the role edges.
V7.0.0
Hero Team — Marvel
New Marvel mode: draft a team against the enemy
  • Added Hero Team — Marvel, a new mode that appears with Perfect Hero when the Marvel filter is selected.
  • Draft five roles — Captain, Vice Captain, Tank, Duelist and Support — then watch the enemy draft from the same leftover pool.
  • No duplicates. One skip for the entire match. Every placement is permanent.
  • When both teams are full, the result explains who won each role, a benefit and a minus for each pick, and why the match flipped.
  • Perfect Hero, the main builder, rankings and character stats are unchanged.
V6.2.1
Perfect Hero — Marvel
Direct slot placement + Marvel image repairs
  • Perfect Hero placement is now handled directly from the five slots — tap or click Strength, Speed, Durability, Intelligence or Powers to lock the current character in.
  • The separate placement-button row has been removed, making the mode faster and cleaner on both mobile and PC.
  • Every placement remains permanent: no respins, no swapping, no undo and no hints.
  • Repaired Nebula with a dedicated full-character Marvel portrait.
  • Repaired Shang-Chi with a dedicated full-character Marvel portrait.
  • All Perfect Hero rankings, roster, stats and core gameplay remain unchanged.
Major modes use x.0.0, feature drops use x.y.0, and small fixes use x.y.z so the release history stays clear.
